title: Terms of the Agreement: The Arranged Amount Recorded on Acceptance of Payment Arrangements
content:
**Terms of the Agreement, Part C — The arranged amount recorded on acceptance**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)

**C.1 Arrears arranged.** The arrears arranged are the past-due amount stated on the offer.

**C.2 Down payment required.** The down payment required is the down payment stated on the offer, and no pledge counts toward the cash part of it: the cash part of the down payment required is the whole down payment required.

**C.3 Down payment paid.** The down payment paid is the latest payment posted to the service account, where it posted on or after the offer date; where the latest payment posted before the offer date, the down payment paid is zero.

**C.4 Set aside.** Nothing is set aside from the down payment paid before the excess is reckoned.

**C.5 Excess.** The excess is the down payment paid less the cash part of the down payment required and less what is set aside, never below zero, and no part of the excess is credited against the arranged amount.

**C.6 Arranged amount.** The arranged amount recorded on acceptance is the arrears arranged less the down payment required and less the part of the excess credited. It is never below zero and never above the tier's largest amount that may be arranged after the down payment, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. The deduction in C.6 is the down payment required stated on the offer, whatever was actually paid.

**Worked figures (hypothetical offer: past-due amount $400.00, down payment required $100.00)**

| Latest payment posted to the service account | Down payment paid | Excess | Arranged amount recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| $130.00, posted after the offer date | $130.00 | $30.00, not credited | $400.00 less $100.00 is $300.00 |
| $100.00, posted on the offer date | $100.00 | $0.00 | $300.00 |
| $130.00, posted the day before the offer date | $0.00 | $0.00 | $300.00 |

**The ceiling (hypothetical tier ceiling of $2500.00)** — on an offer stating a past-due amount of $2900.00 and a down payment required of $290.00, the arrears less the down payment come to $2610.00, and the arranged amount recorded is held at $2500.00.
